name: Boiler (Steam)

pages.title: Boiler (Steam)
pages.text:
A Create **boiler** is Fluid Tanks of water, heated from below, with Steam Engines attached. The minimum is 4 tanks.\
\
More heat gives a higher **power level**; each level runs one more engine at full strength. Goggles show it.\
\
Cold Sweat's Boiler is a different block, an area heater.
